name: U01 - Quick Find Components in Toolbars
brief: Teaching: Quick Find Components in Toolbars
context:
Quick Find Components in Toolbars:

If you want to find the location of a certain component in the toolbars, click
"ctrl+alt+click"
on component while holding.

Try this out with the "Rebuild Curve" component.
